name: Stanley x LoveShackFancy Limited Edition 40oz Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler – Floral Collaboration Collection ( RANDOM COLOUR )
description: Indulge in the perfect fusion of utility and high-fashion. The Stanley x LoveShackFancy collection reimagines the iconic 40oz Quencher H2.0 FlowState™ Tumbler in four exclusive, enchanting floral patterns. Designed for those who appreciate the coquette and cottagecore aesthetics, each tumbler features a glossy finish, gold-toned accents, and a matching decorative straw topper.Crafted from recycled stainless steel, this tumbler is built to last and designed to fit comfortably in most car cup holders. Whether you are heading to a garden party, the gym, or the office, the double-wall vacuum insulation ensures your beverages stay ice-cold for up to 48 hours. The advanced FlowState™ lid features a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening, a wide mouth for chugging, and a full-cover top to prevent splashes.Collection Options:Everbloom 60s: A vibrant purple floral dream.Ribbon Rosa: Classic pink roses on a clean white backdrop.Blooming Heirloom: Delicate pink stripes and rosebuds.Happy Thoughts: Whimsical blue and white floral patterns.Key Features & SpecificationsSuperior Insulation: Keeps drinks cold for 11 hours and iced for up to 2 days.FlowState™ Lid: Versatile 3-position lid with a reusable straw and silicone seal.Sustainable Design: Made from 90% recycled BPA-free 18/8 stainless steel.Travel-Ready: Ergonomic comfort-grip handle and tapered base to fit vehicle cup holders.Exclusive Details: Features a limited-edition LoveShackFancy logo and custom-designed packaging.Dishwasher Safe: Easy to clean for daily use.
